_source: The MapLevelProgress header runs from Map (A) and Level (B) through Author (X); level strings and compressed exports occupy the configured columns in between.
_note: Column indexes are 0-based (0=A, 1=B, ...). These are just the starting defaults — the Remote Data tab also lets a designer override each field column from its own UI (letters, e.g. 'D'), in case the real sheet's layout ever shifts; this file only supplies the initial values shown there.
